# observability (cloudspider-observability) v1.0.0

Observability for the EKS cluster: Container Insights (the CloudWatch Observability add-on with Pod Identity, log groups with a retention) and a basic alarm set (ALB 5XX, unhealthy targets, node not ready) to an SNS topic with an email opt-in.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| clusterName | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-up | the EKS cluster it runs on |
| containerInsights | on \| off | off | CloudWatch Observability add-on |
| alarms | on \| off | off | ALB 5XX / unhealthy targets / node not ready alarms to SNS (card default on) |
| alertEmail | must be an email address |  | SNS email subscription |
| dashboard | on \| off | on | CloudWatch dashboard <cluster>-overview |
| retentionDays | 1..3653 | 7 | log retention |

## Outputs

- `alertTopic`
- `alarmCount`
- `insights`
- `dashboardLink`
- `INSIGHTS_GROUPS`
- `insightsGroups`
- `alarmsMonthly`
- `dashboardName`

## Guarantees

- Providers pinned: `@aws-sdk/client-elastic-load-balancing-v2` 3.1149.0, `@pulumi/aws` 7.50.0, `@pulumi/kubernetes` 4.34.2, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.
